resolution.rejection_description: Rejected on a mandatory biometric update because the face matched candidates belonging to a different parent Aadhaar, and those candidates were in-process enrolments that do not yet hold an Aadhaar.
resolution.synthesis: The resident submitted a first-time biometric update, which is de-duplicated like a fresh enrolment and must not match any other identity. The face matched enrolments still in flight under a different parent, which points to the same person already being enrolled elsewhere, so the packet was rejected. The competing enrolment must be resolved through the Regional Office.
